units.source_text: 公子看了“锦绣春衣”等语，不解其意，侧着头思索。

en.t: The prince read phrases such as “brocade spring robes,” but could not understand their meaning, and tilted his head in thought.

units.source_text: 这时候大辅命妇提过一个很重的包袱来，

en.t: Just then, Taifu no Myobu brought over a very heavy bundle.

units.source_text: 打开一看，里面包着一只古风的衣箱。

en.t: When they opened it and looked inside, an old-fashioned clothes chest was wrapped within.

units.source_text: 命妇说道：“您看！

en.t: Myobu said, “Look at this!

units.source_text: 这怎么不笑煞人呢？

en.t: How could anyone help laughing at it?

units.source_text: 她说是给您元旦日穿的，特地派我送来。

en.t: She said it was for you to wear on New Year’s Day, and specially sent me to deliver it.

units.source_text: 我不便退回她。

en.t: I could hardly return it to her.

units.source_text: 擅自把它搁置起来呢，又辜负了她的一片好心。

en.t: But if I simply put it away on my own, I would betray her kind intentions.

units.source_text: 因此只得送来给您看。”

en.t: So I had no choice but to bring it for you to see.”

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“擅自把它搁置起来，太对人不起了。

en.t: Prince Genji said, “It would be far too discourteous to put it away without a word.

units.source_text: 我是一个哭湿了衣袖没人给烘干的人，

en.t: I am someone whose sleeves are wet with tears, with no one to dry them for me.

units.source_text: 蒙她送衣服，我很感谢！”

en.t: I am very grateful that she has sent me clothing!”

units.source_text: 此外并不说什么话。

en.t: Beyond that, he said nothing more.

units.source_text: 他想：“唉，这两句诗真不高明，

en.t: He thought, “Ah, these two lines of poetry are really rather poor.

units.source_text: 大概是她自己用尽了心血作出来的吧。

en.t: She probably made them herself with all the effort she could muster.

units.source_text: 那个侍女侍从倘在她身边，一定会替她修改。

en.t: If that lady-in-waiting Jiju had been at her side, she would surely have revised them for her.

units.source_text: 除了这个人以外，再没有能教她的老师了。”

en.t: Apart from that woman, there is no teacher who can guide her.”

units.source_text: 想到这里，令人泄气。

en.t: Thinking this far left him dispirited.

units.source_text: 他推想这是小姐用尽了心血作出来的，

en.t: He imagined that the young lady had made this with the utmost care she could manage.

units.source_text: 便觉得世间所谓可贵的诗歌，大概就是这样的作品吧。

en.t: Then he felt that perhaps what people called precious poetry in this world was just such a thing.

units.source_text: 于是脸上露出微笑。

en.t: At that, a smile appeared on his face.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇看到这光景，不知道他作何感想，不免脸上泛起了红晕。

en.t: Seeing this, Taifu no Myobu could not tell what he was thinking, and a blush rose unavoidably to her face.
